authority_note: Old source and tests are EVIDENCE, never authority. PaySwap 3.0 architecture (spec/architecture/*) wins over the old repository. This matrix records what exists and what it maps to; it never authorizes copying. No implementation is created by this record.

classification_legend.REUSE: Old file(s) carried into PaySwap 3.0 substantially verbatim. Requires exact old-repo file list (hard rule).
classification_legend.ADAPT: Old file(s) carried in with bounded modifications (import paths, error-taxonomy/authority owner, invariant numbering); structure preserved. Requires exact old-repo file list (hard rule applied as for REUSE).
classification_legend.PORT: Concept + contract shape carried to a new authority owner in the canonical repository, substantially re-authored; the old files are the reference contract and test evidence, not copy source.
classification_legend.REWRITE: Net-new implementation in the canonical repository; old repo is evidence/reference only (spec text, tests as behavioral oracle).
classification_legend.RETIRE: Not carried forward under the PaySwap 3.0 architecture. Reclassification requires a Work Order/ADR.

zcode_equivalent_legend.NONE: No equivalent surface in the ZCode pin; the item is net-new financial-domain work on the platform substrate.
zcode_equivalent_legend.PARTIAL: A ZCode surface exists that hosts or parallels part of the item (platform substrate), but the financial semantics remain net-new and authority-disjoint.
zcode_equivalent_legend.PATHS: Concrete canonical-repo path(s) at the pin that form the mapped surface.
